children: Shares of IG Group Holdings plc (LSE:IGG) plunged ~27% intraday after earnings showed weaker OTC client retention and missed non‑OTC revenue, yet the group—fresh from agreeing to buy Underdog for up to $1.3bn—says it still expects to meet its medium‑term outlook beyond 2026.
IGG Shares Plunge Largest One-Day Drop
: IG Group (IGG) shares plunged ~27% intraday, the largest one-day drop since Dec 2016. Company says it still expects to meet its medium-term outlook beyond 2026.
IG Group To Buy Underdog For Up To $1.3bn
: IG Group agreed July 30 to buy prediction‑markets firm Underdog for up to $1.3bn. Underdog posted Q3 revenue ~$105m, 11m registered accounts, 5m+ depositors. Close expected late 2026–early 2027.
OTC Retention Drops, Non-OTC Revenue Misses
: RBC Capital Markets says IG Group's OTC client retention fell to about 70% and non‑OTC revenues missed expectations, both cited as key drivers of IGG's recent earnings shortfall.
: IG Group expects 2026 group EBITDA margin, excluding one-off costs, to be in the low-40% range. This guidance pertains to the 2026 fiscal period and excludes non-recurring items.
: IG Group expects to meet medium‑term guidance beyond 2026, citing customer growth and higher OTC revenue retention. Q3 update set for 22 Oct 2026; institutional webinar on 8 Oct 2026.
